[SWS_DM_00950] Configuration of DTC priority as extended data record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referenced by
Diagnos-
ticEdrDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
Diagnos-
ticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_DTC_PRIORITY
,
the DM shall set the value of this
internal data element
to the DTC priority as-
signed by
DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.priority
for this DTC.
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
